_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking outage reports on Wireless Choices

description: Return community outage reports made on Wireless Choices for one provider (provider_slug), one Australian postcode, or a provider in a postcode: the number of reports in the last 24 hours and the last 7 days by issue type and how many reports the counts are based on, plus up to 3 of the most recent resolved outages published on the carrier outage registers required by the ACMA, each with its source link. Community reports are made by members of the public and are not confirmed by the provider. Providers are identified by the same slugs as plans.

postcode.description: Australian postcode, four digits, e.g. 2320 or 0870

provider_slug.description: Provider slug, e.g. telstra, optus, boost-mobile; nbn for nbn

name: get_outage_status

as_of.description: When the outage data was last confirmed current, ISO timestamp

reports_24h.description: Report count; the string "1-2" when the exact count is withheld to protect reporters

reports_7d.description: Report count; the string "1-2" when the exact count is withheld to protect reporters

error.description: Error code, present only on an error result

areas.description: Up to 5 affected areas as published

ended_on.description: End date, Australia/Sydney, ISO date; null when the register published an end before the start

published_by.description: Carrier that published the register entry

resolved_by.description: Carrier the register names as responsible for resolving the outage
